info.title: lineup
info.description: Channel and playlist manager for Jellyfin Live TV

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of name, tvg-id or source key.

get.summary: Channels offered by the enabled sources. With `q`, the best matches first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: matched against channel ids and display names.

post.summary:
Fetch sources now and wait for the result. Fetches run one at a time, so this waits for any fetch
already running.
Adds a source and starts fetching it in the background.

patch.summary:
A URL change keeps the current guide data until the new URL's first successful fetch, which starts
immediately.

post.summary:
Send a synthetic `hook.test` event now (one attempt, no debounce) and return the logged result.
For a Jellyfin hook this really starts a guide refresh.

playlists.description: Slugs of playlists containing this channel.

source_key.description: Canonical key used for de-duplication (unique per source kind).

stream_url.description: Stream URL as currently emitted in playlists.

playlists.description: Playlists (by slug) to append the new channel to.

oneOf.description: Either a structured source, or free-form `input` (ace id, acestream:// link, vk.com URL, any URL).

ChannelPatch.description: Partial update. Absent fields are left unchanged; for nullable fields, `null` clears.

EpgChannel.description: A channel offered by a guide source.

score.description: Match score in [0, 1] when the list came from a search.

source_ids.description: Sources to fetch; all enabled sources when empty.

channels.description: Channels in the published generation (when updated).

programmes.description: Programmes kept in the published generation (when updated).

current_gen.description: Generation being served; null until the first successful fetch.

priority.description: When several sources carry the same channel id, the highest priority wins.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code: not_found, conflict, invalid, internal.

debounce_secs.description: Events are collected until none has arrived for this long, then delivered together.

api_key.description: API key (Dashboard → API Keys). Write-only: responses show a mask.

followup_minutes.description:
A second refresh this many minutes after the last delivery, once Jellyfin's cached
guide download has expired; 0 turns it off.

task_id.description: Scheduled task id; found by its key `RefreshGuide` when empty.

oneOf.description: Sends the event envelope as JSON.

headers.description: Extra request headers. Values are write-only: responses show a mask.

events.description: Defaults: `playlist.changed` and `epg.updated` for Jellyfin, every event for webhooks.

attempt.description: 1 for the first try; retries count up.

ok.description: The receiver answered 2xx (accepted; not a guarantee that it finished).

oneOf.description: Replaces the whole config; masked secrets sent back unchanged keep their stored values.

diff.description: Fields where the file differs from the existing channel (existing metadata is never overwritten).

skipped_lines.description: Lines that could not be parsed into an entry.

position.description: 1-based insert position; appended when absent or beyond the end.

channel_ids.description: Full new order of channel ids.

slugs.description: Playlists to refresh; all when absent or empty.

duplicate_of.description: Existing channel with the same source, if any.

engine_name.description: Name the Acestream engine reports for this content id, as-is.

matches.description: Best guide channels for the suggested name, best first (up to 5).

suggestion.description: Suggested values for a new channel; shown as editable defaults.

warnings.description: Problems that did not stop the resolve, such as an unreachable engine.

epg_refresh_hours.description: Hours between scheduled EPG fetches (the first runs 3 minutes after start); 0 turns the schedule off.

oneOf.description: Acestream content id (40 lowercase hex chars), played through acexy.
VK video, played through the VK proxy.

Source.description: A channel's stream source. The full URL is built from the per-kind base URL in settings.

is_event.description: VK links are usually one-off live events.
